<style>
.chayce-logo-link{text-decoration:none!important}
.navbar .container .upper-side .logo{margin-left:80px!important}
@media(max-width:767px){.navbar .container .upper-side .logo{margin-left:0!important}}








.page-section{padding:80px 0}
.page-section.grey{background:var(--bg-cool)}
.area-copy{display:flex;gap:44px;max-width:960px;margin:0 auto;align-items:flex-start}
.area-copy .area-rail{flex:0 0 220px;padding-right:30px;border-right:1px solid var(--border-warm)}
.area-copy .area-body{flex:1;max-width:640px}
.area-copy h2{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:28px;color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 20px;line-height:1.3}
.area-copy p{color:#555;font-size:16px;line-height:1.8;margin:0 0 18px}
.area-copy p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.area-eyebrow{font-size:14px;letter-spacing:2.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);font-weight:500;margin:0}
@media(max-width:800px){.area-copy{flex-direction:column;gap:24px}.area-copy .area-rail{flex:none;border-right:none;padding-right:0}.area-copy .area-body{max-width:100%}}
.area-honest{background:var(--bg-cream);border-left:3px solid var(--gold);padding:26px 30px;margin:36px 0 0}
.area-honest p{margin:0;font-size:17px;color:var(--slate)}
.area-pkg-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:24px;max-width:900px;margin:0 auto}
.area-pkg-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border-light);padding:28px 26px}.area-pkg-card .num{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg-cream-deep);color:var(--gold-dark);font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:14px}
.area-pkg-card h4{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:19px;color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 8px}
.area-pkg-card p{color:var(--grey-mid);font-size:16px;line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 14px}
.area-pkg-card a{color:var(--gold);font-weight:500;font-size:15px;text-decoration:none}
.area-pkg-card a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.ac-intro{padding:84px 0 72px;background:#fff}.ac-intro .container{max-width:1080px}.ac-intro-copy{max-width:720px;margin:0 auto 48px;text-align:center}.ac-eyebrow{display:block;color:var(--gold-dark);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:14px}.ac-intro h2{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:34px;line-height:1.25;color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 20px}.ac-intro h2 em{color:var(--gold);font-style:normal}.ac-intro-copy p{color:#555;font-size:16px;line-height:1.8;margin:0 0 16px}.ac-intro-copy a{color:var(--ink);text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:var(--gold);text-underline-offset:3px}.ac-tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px}.ac-tile{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;min-height:230px;padding:20px;background-size:cover;background-position:center;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(26,26,26,.14);transition:transform .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease}.ac-tile::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(14,16,20,.88) 0%,rgba(14,16,20,.35) 60%,rgba(14,16,20,.15) 100%)}.ac-tile::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:20px;bottom:0;width:40px;height:3px;background:var(--gold);transition:width .25s ease}.ac-tile:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 22px 44px rgba(26,26,26,.22)}.ac-tile:hover::after{width:calc(100% - 40px)}.ac-tile span{position:relative;z-index:1}.ac-tile-n{font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:3px;color:var(--gold-lighter);margin-bottom:6px}.ac-tile-t{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:21px;line-height:1.25;padding-bottom:12px}@media(max-width:900px){.ac-tiles{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.ac-intro{padding:60px 0 52px}.ac-intro h2{font-size:28px}}@media(max-width:480px){.ac-tile{min-height:170px}}
.area-links{list-style:none;margin:26px 0 0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:14px}.area-links li{margin:0}.area-links a{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border-warm-2);border-left:3px solid var(--gold);padding:16px 20px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink);font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-weight:500;font-size:16px;line-height:1.4;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}.area-links a span{font-weight:400;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--grey-mid)}.area-links a:hover{border-color:var(--gold-dark);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(35,40,58,.08)}
.pkg-faq-band{background:var(--bg-warm);padding:80px 0}
.pkg-faq-band .container{max-width:760px}
.pkg-faq-band h2{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:28px;color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 30px;text-align:center}
.pkg-faq{margin:0}
.pkg-faq details{border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-warm-2);padding:20px 0}
.pkg-faq details:first-child{border-top:1px solid var(--border-warm-2)}
.pkg-faq summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-weight:500;font-size:17px;color:var(--ink)}
.pkg-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.pkg-faq summary::after{content:'+';flex-shrink:0;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:19px;font-weight:400;color:var(--gold-dark)}
.pkg-faq details[open] summary::after{content:'\2212'}
.pkg-faq p{color:var(--grey-mid);font-size:17px;line-height:1.8;margin:12px 0 0}
@media(max-width:640px){.area-pkg-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.pkg-close-cta{background:#fff;padding:70px 0;text-align:center}.pkg-close-cta h2{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:28px;color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 12px}.pkg-close-cta p{color:var(--grey-mid);font-size:17px;margin:0 0 26px}.pkg-close-cta .btn-row{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}.pkg-close-cta .btn-row a{display:inline-block;padding:15px 32px;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;border-radius:2px}.pkg-close-cta .btn-row .primary{background:var(--oxblood);color:#fff}.pkg-close-cta .btn-row .primary:hover{background:var(--oxblood-dark)}.pkg-close-cta .btn-row .ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--ink)}.pkg-close-cta .btn-row .ghost:hover{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}@media(max-width:480px){.pkg-close-cta .btn-row{flex-direction:column}.pkg-close-cta .btn-row a{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}}
</style>
